REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.R. REGISTRY File No. N.D. 2554/22 Date 14th June 1933.）

Subject (in full) Communist meeting in Western Chapei.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by （签名）

Agent A-2453 reports that at a meeting held by
six members of the executive branch of the Shanghai Western
Special District Committee of the local Chinese Communist
Party on the bridge opposite the Central Mint in Western
Chapei between 6 and 7 p.m. June 13, 1933, the following
resolutions were passed :-
(1) That an investigation be made regarding the loyalty of
certain members in industrial concerns who have been
recently enrolled as members.
(2) That investigations be conducted regarding members of
all reactionary cliques.
(3) That the establishment of C. Y. organizations be
accelerated in factories prior to the Anniversary of the
General Strike of Workers in Canton and Hongkong which
falls on June 21.
(4) That investigations be made regarding the meetings
held by "cells" in factories.
(5) That the agitation started by the workers of the
N.W.K. No.3 Cotton Mill for improved working conditions
be supported.
(6) That owing to the increasing number of reactionaries
who are hindering the work of the Communist Party,
verbal propaganda be carried out instead of the
dissemination of handbills.

The description of Li Siao Oo Ts (李小五仔),
secretary of the Shanghai Western Special District Committee
of the local Chinese Communist Party, who presided over the
gathering, is as follows :-

S.2. 特别股。
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 S.R. 登记处 档案号 N.D. 2554/22 日期 1933年6月14日。）

主题（全称）：闸北西部共产党会议。

制作人：警探顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）。呈送人：（签名）

特工 A-2453 报告称，1933年6月13日下午6时至7时之间，在闸北西部中央造币厂对面桥上，当地中国共产党上海西区特别委员会执行委员会的六名成员举行了一次会议，会上通过了以下决议：
(1) 对最近被吸收为成员的某些在企业中工作的人员的忠诚度进行调查。
(2) 对所有反动派系成员进行调查。
(3) 在6月21日省港大罢工纪念日之前，加快在工厂中建立共产主义青年团（C. Y.）组织。
(4) 对工厂内“小组”举行的会议进行调查。
(5) 支持西北纺织第三棉纺厂工人发起的改善工作条件的斗争。
(6) 鉴于阻碍中国共产党工作的反动分子日益增多，应进行口头宣传，不再散发传单。

主持会议的当地中国共产党上海西区特别委员会书记李小五仔（Li Siao Oo Ts）的体貌特征如下：
年龄约25岁；身高5英尺3英寸；长脸；肤色黝黑
